# Knowledge Base: erdos-485-oq-02

## Problem Understanding

The open question asks whether f(k) → ∞ can be proved combinatorially (via sumsets) rather than algebraically (via height theory).

## Key Results (This Session)

1. support(P²) ⊆ support(P) + support(P) — always holds
2. For nonneg coefficients, equality holds → termCount(P²) ≥ 2k-1
3. Cancellation barrier: mixed-sign coefficients can eliminate sumset elements

## Dead Ends

- Direct sumset bounds fail for general polynomials due to cancellation
